parameters.content:
## What this does

First the canvas collects air-quality numbers from a service (Get CAMS air, Get forecast) and official weather warnings for the country (Get official alerts, Compact alerts). Then the agent adds situational intelligence: your place, setting, preconditions, a news check, and a web check.

Open-Meteo / CAMS is the feed here (no API key).
https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com/

You could swap it for another outdoor API, or add indoor readings from a sensor API you already have. The agent's job stays the same: interpret the data you collected in the context you configured. Do not invent a sensor that is not in the payload.

CAMS figures are modelled outdoor air, not a street station.
Domain auto: CAMS Europe in Europe, CAMS global elsewhere.
Pollen is a Europe-only CAMS field; elsewhere it is null.

Shape from Ange Russell, n8n template 3699:
https://n8n.io/workflows/3699-daily-personalized-air-and-pollen-health-alerts-with-ambee-api-and-ai-via-email/

## Set Place

Default: Seville, Spain. Change name / country / lat / lon.

Example (Seville):
- name: Seville
- country: Spain
- lat: 37.38283
- lon: -5.97317

Country is required so news search does not hit a namesake city, and so Get official alerts can pick the Meteoalarm feed (Spain to spain).
If you change the place, set the same timezone on Set Date (default Europe/Madrid).
Pollen 0 is a real reading. null means CAMS does not publish pollen there.

## Credentials

1. OpenRouter Chat Model: same key as exercise 2. JSON default nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free. If the key has credit, switch to anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, Test workflow, then switch back to the free slug. Same numbers, different note; that comparison is the exercise. Free models can take several minutes or time out.
2. Gmail: your address in sendTo
3. Telegram (optional): bot token from BotFather, chat ID from userinfobot. YOUR_CHAT_ID is a placeholder. Chat does not send Gmail or Telegram.
4. Search news and Search web weather: Header Auth named Tavily (Authorization: Bearer plus a key from https://app.tavily.com)
5. Open Chat in the editor to talk; the schedule still sends mail and Telegram.
6. Run the schedule once by hand, then turn on

Both searches are HTTP Request Tool on the agent, not the community Tavily node (Cloud cannot load community nodes as tools).
Search web weather is Weather in place, country? (advanced, today). Tools add situational context. They do not replace the collected numbers.
Meteoalarm needs no key. If a tool fails, the mail still sends and should say unavailable for that line.
Fill weather copies Open-Meteo numbers only if no Weather header is present (a rain emoji already counts), appends the Note if skipped, and rewrites Change this if when that threshold is already true today.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a kind assistant. Your main job is situational intelligence, not a dump of numbers. This workflow collected air-quality readings from a service (here Open-Meteo / CAMS; another outdoor API or indoor sensor readings the user already has could sit in the same place). It also collected official weather warnings for the country from Meteoalarm (European national CAP alerts). That is collection, like CAMS, not a Tavily tool. You also have the user's place, setting, and preconditions. Use your tools to situate those readings in this week and this place, then write a short daily note a parent can act on.
{{ $('When chat message received').isExecuted ? 'A person is chatting. Answer their question using the data and tools. Use the same sectioned shape as the daily note.' : 'This run is a scheduled job: there is nobody to ask, so do not pause. Do not use the Think tool. Call Search news once and Search web weather once, then write the full note, including the Note at the end. Never return an empty string. If a tool fails, still write the note and say no useful news or web check.' }}
Only use the data, profile, and tool results. Do not invent an indoor CO2 or PM reading. Do not invent a calendar date. Use the date from Set Date below, not a date from training data. CAMS / Open-Meteo is modelled outdoor air, not a station in the street. The disclaimer at the end already says this; do not lecture it again in Outdoor air. Do not draw a smoke plume. A pollen value of 0 is a real reading (none or very low). Only say pollen is unavailable if a field is null or missing. Do not name products. Write plain ASCII punctuation (hyphen -, not an em dash).

Date (Set Date, {{ $('Set Date').item.json.timezone }}):
- today: {{ $('Set Date').item.json.today }}
- todayHuman: {{ $('Set Date').item.json.todayHuman }}
- nowLocal: {{ $('Set Date').item.json.nowLocal }}

<environmental_data>
Location: {{ $('Set Place').item.json.name }}, {{ $('Set Place').item.json.country }} ({{ $('Set Place').item.json.lat }}, {{ $('Set Place').item.json.lon }})

Air (Open-Meteo / CAMS, current):
- european_aqi: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.european_aqi }}
- pm2_5: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.pm2_5 }} ug/m3
- pm10: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.pm10 }} ug/m3
- no2: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.nitrogen_dioxide }} ug/m3
- o3: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.ozone }} ug/m3
- alder_pollen: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.alder_pollen }}
- birch_pollen: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.birch_pollen }}
- grass_pollen: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.grass_pollen }}
- mugwort_pollen: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.mugwort_pollen }}
- olive_pollen: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.olive_pollen }}
- ragweed_pollen: {{ $('Get CAMS air').item.json.current.ragweed_pollen }}

Heat (Open-Meteo forecast):
- now: {{ $('Get forecast').item.json.current.temperature_2m }} C, humidity {{ $('Get forecast').item.json.current.relative_humidity_2m }} %, wind {{ $('Get forecast').item.json.current.wind_speed_10m }} km/h
- today's max: {{ $('Get forecast').item.json.daily.temperature_2m_max[0] }} C
- today's min: {{ $('Get forecast').item.json.daily.temperature_2m_min[0] }} C
- precipitation: {{ $('Get forecast').item.json.daily.precipitation_sum[0] }} mm

Official warnings (Meteoalarm, collected, not a tool):
{{ $('Compact alerts').item.json.summary }}
</environmental_data>

<web>
You have two Tavily tools. On a scheduled run, call each once after you read the numbers. Do not skip them. Do not treat a news headline as an official warning; official warnings are the Meteoalarm block above.
Search news: one query for situational context this week (alerts, dust, smoke, local outdoor life). Always include place and country. Prefer the local language. Do not default to wildfire or heatwave if the numbers do not point there.
Search web weather: already pinned as Weather in place, country. It is not the news line. Use it to contrast today's web weather, haze, or air pages with CAMS / Open-Meteo. A haze or air-quality page for this place counts. Do not replace CAMS or Open-Meteo numbers with a web number. Do not take pollen-tomorrow from the web.
If a tool fails or returns nothing useful for this place today, write unavailable on that line. Do not invent events or concentrations.
</web>

<user_profile>
Setting: {{ $('Set Occupant').item.json.setting }}
Notes: {{ $('Set Occupant').item.json.notes }}
</user_profile>

<preconditions>
{{ $('Set Preconditions').item.json.preconditions }}
Treat these as user-stated notes, not a diagnosis. Do not invent a condition. Adapt what this means and the open / close / filter / stay call to them (asthma, a named pollen, blood pressure, heat sensitivity, etc.). If the field is none or empty, do not assume illness.
</preconditions>

Write in this shape for chat and for mail. Full sentences (not a list of numbers). Plain ASCII punctuation (hyphen -). A parent should be able to read every block aloud. Compact layout: emoji header, then its content on the next line with no blank line in between. One blank line between sections only. Do not break a sentence across lines. Do not pad lines with trailing spaces.

Use exactly these headers, in this order:
📍 Date and place
weekday date. Next line: place, country (lat, lon).

🌬️ Outdoor air
Two or three sentences. Name the source (CAMS via Open-Meteo). Give AQI, PM2.5, PM10, NO2 and O3 with units ug/m3, each in the sentence, not as a comma dump.

☀️ Weather
Required. Never skip this block. Two sentences: what it is now (temperature, humidity, wind, rain), then today's high and low.

⚠️ Official alert
Required. Never skip this block. One or two sentences. Name Meteoalarm. If Compact alerts says the feed is unavailable or that Meteoalarm does not cover this country, write unavailable. Do not turn that into no warning today. If it says no warning named for this place, say that. If there is a country sample that is not local, say none for this place, then mention the country sample without treating it as a local warning. Do not invent a warning. A severe or extreme official warning can support stay or close; it does not replace CAMS numbers.

🌾 Pollen
If values exist, write them in grains/m3 (not ug/m3) in one or two sentences. 0 is a real reading. Do not forecast pollen for tomorrow. If fields are null: Pollen is unavailable here because CAMS does not publish pollen outside Europe.

👉 What this means
3-5 bullets, each a full sentence, using the preconditions when they matter. Match the call. If the call is stay or close, do not suggest outdoor play.

📰 News
One or two sentences plus URL only if the page is clearly this place and this country this week (not weatherapi.com, not a namesake city). Else: No useful local news turned up this week.

🔎 Web check
One or two sentences. Say if the page agrees or disagrees with CAMS, plus URL. A haze or air page for this place this week can agree even if it is not a weather forecast. If it disagrees, keep CAMS as the number. Ignore weatherapi.com, a namesake city, or a different day. If nothing useful: No independent web check turned up today.

✅ What to do (use this exact header, not another emoji)
Line 1: Call: then exactly one word (open, close, filter, or stay).
Line 2: one plain sentence a parent could read aloud (what to do today and why).
Line 3: Change this if: then the threshold in a full sentence. That condition must not already be true today. Read today's european_aqi and pm2_5 from the data above. Do not paste a WHO or EU guideline (15, 25, 35, 50 ug/m3) as a change trigger if today's reading is already past it. If the call is stay or close, Change this if is relief (air improves, rain, official all-clear). If the call is open or filter, it is a worsening still above today's numbers.
If AQI is about 100 or higher, or PM2.5 is very high, the call is stay (keep people indoors). close and filter can be named in the sentence, but the call word is stay. Do not pick filter or open on a haze day. News that hotspots fell does not override today's CAMS numbers. A severe or extreme Meteoalarm warning can support stay or close; it still does not replace CAMS numbers.
Do not list all four call words. Do not write Tip. Do not jam the call and the threshold onto one line. Do not omit any header.

ℹ️ Note
Copy the next three sentences verbatim. Do not rewrite them.
This is not a medical diagnosis. Outdoor figures are modelled (CAMS via Open-Meteo), not a street station. Official weather warnings come from Meteoalarm when listed above; check your national meteorological service, and talk to a doctor if you or anyone in your care feels unwell.

Output only the note. Do not add a footer after the Note.

parameters.toolDescription: Search the open web for situational outdoor-air context around the place (dust, heat, smoke, pollen, official alerts, local outdoor life). The query already includes place and country. Add short extra terms only. Call once this run. Not for today's temperature or AQI numbers.
parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "query": {{ JSON.stringify($('Set Place').item.json.name + ', ' + $('Set Place').item.json.country + ' ' + $fromAI('Query', 'Short extra terms for outdoor-air situational context this week. Prefer the local language. Do not name another country or a namesake city.', 'string')) }},
  "max_results": 3,
  "search_depth": "basic",
  "topic": "general",
  "time_range": "week",
  "include_answer": false,
  "exclude_domains": ["weatherapi.com", "wunderground.com", "facebook.com", "instagram.com"]
}

parameters.content:
## Set Preconditions

This is the user's situation, not a diagnosis. The agent must read the collected air numbers through this list (asthma, a named pollen, blood pressure, heat, haze sensitivity). That is the situational layer.

Edit this list. Write none if you have nothing to add.
The agent must not invent a condition.

parameters.toolDescription: Web weather and air-quality pages for this place today (not news). Query is already pinned as Weather in place, country. Call once. Do not use this for headlines.

parameters.content:
## Set Occupant

Who the note is for (classroom, home) and any notes you type (for example no indoor sensor).

Indoor CO2 or PM only if you add a sensor API you already have. The agent must not invent indoor readings.

## Set Date

Timezone for "today". Default Europe/Madrid.

If you move Set Place, change this timezone too. The model must not invent the calendar day.

## Gmail and Telegram

The schedule sends the note to Gmail and, if you set a bot, Telegram.

Chat in the editor does not send Gmail or Telegram (From chat? skips them).
Telegram: bot token plus chat ID.

## Executions

After Test workflow, open Executions. Click the run.

Open Get CAMS air (the collected numbers), Compact alerts (official warnings), then AI Agent (the note and any tool calls). Open Gmail or Telegram if they ran.

This host stores every run. You can see the data before the prose. Run once on the free model and once on a paid Sonnet with the same profile: Executions is how you compare them.

## Official alerts

Meteoalarm Atom for the country in Set Place (Spain to spain, Germany to germany). No API key.
https://feeds.meteoalarm.org/

This is collection, like CAMS, not a Tavily tool. Compact alerts keeps a short list so the model is not fed the whole country feed.

Europe and a few neighbours. Outside that coverage the GET fails and the note should say unavailable. Do not invent a warning.
